$comment: Privacy / visibility matrix for the PyArcana supervisor / cohort system. Generated by product_hardening Phase 2. The matrix is the single source of truth consulted by src/lib/permissions.ts and the cohort API routes. Default deny: any (role, field) pair not listed here is DENY.

membership.joinedAt: When the learner joined the cohort.
membership.consentVersion: Privacy policy version the learner consented to.
membership.invitedBy: User ID of the inviting supervisor.
membership.leftAt: When the learner left the cohort (if applicable).
membership.removedBy: User ID of the admin/supervisor who removed the learner (if applicable).

progress.lastActivity: Timestamp of most recent Progress.completedAt across all sections (day granularity).

assessment.examAttemptsCount: Number of exam attempts per section.
assessment.examLastAttemptAt: Timestamp of most recent exam attempt per section.
assessment.examTimeSpentSec: Total time spent on exams (aggregate, not per-question).
assessment.examRawAnswers: Raw answer JSON stored on ExamAttempt.answers (the actual selections).
assessment.examVariantSeed: Which question variants were assigned (anti-plagiarism audit trail).
assessment.exerciseAttemptsCount: Number of exercise attempts per exerciseId.
assessment.exerciseCorrectRate: Percentage of exercises correct on first attempt.
assessment.exerciseUsedHintRate: Percentage of exercises where a hint was used.
assessment.exerciseRawCode: The actual code the learner submitted for an exercise.

badges.badgeTopBlockingReasons: Top 3 blocking reasons across all blocked badges (Stephen Fry redacted).
badges.badgeFullEligibilityReport: The full eligibility report per badge (with per-requirement pass/fail detail).

projects.projectSubmissionStatus: Whether each capstone project has been submitted.
projects.projectRubricBreakdown: Per-criterion rubric scores for a submitted project.
projects.projectRawSubmission: The actual code/artefacts the learner submitted.

feedback.feedbackReportCount: Count of feedback reports submitted by the learner.
feedback.feedbackReportTypes: Types of feedback submitted (BUG / IDEA / etc.).
feedback.feedbackReportBodies: The actual text the learner wrote in feedback reports.

subscription.subscriptionPlan: The learner's plan code (free / pro / team).
subscription.subscriptionCurrentPeriodEnd: When the current billing period ends.

auth.passwordHash: Bcrypt hash of the learner's password.

otherCohorts.otherCohortMemberships: List of other cohorts the learner is a member of.
otherCohorts.otherCohortProgress: The learner's progress in other cohorts (which is the same progress, but scoped to another cohort's dashboard view).

COHORT_SUPERVISOR.$comment: Same as COHORT_OWNER except no membership management fields (invitedBy / removedBy / removalReason) and no consentVersion.

COHORT_REPORTER.$comment: Same as COHORT_SUPERVISOR but no assessment time-spent and no exercise hint-rate (those are engagement proxies that a pure reporter does not need).

COHORT_LEARNER.$comment: A learner sees their OWN data fully (within the cohort context) plus the cohort name. They do not see other members' data.

ADMIN.$comment: Admin sees everything across all cohorts, including raw answers, private feedback, and payment details. ADMIN is the only role that can see raw auth data (password hash is never exposed via API even to ADMIN — only the hash's existence is visible).

explicitlyDenied.$comment: These fields are DENY for every role except ADMIN. They are listed here for documentation; the runtime does not need to consult this list (default deny covers it). passwordHash is never exposed via API to anyone, including ADMIN (admins reset passwords, they do not read them).

staticSiteGuard.$comment: When IS_STATIC_SITE === true, all visibility is DENY for supervisor / cohort fields. The static site has no supervisor context.

consentVersioning.$comment: When the privacy_visibility_matrix.json is updated (e.g. a new field is added to a role's visible set, or a field is moved from visible to denied), the consentVersion must be bumped. Existing members with consentVersion < new version are prompted to re-consent on next cohort view (Phase 7+; Phase 6 ships with consentVersion 1.0 and no re-consent flow).
reConsentTriggers: Adding a field to any role's visible set
Moving a field from denied to visible
Changing the default from DENY to ALLOW for any (role, field) pair
